interface.shortDescription: Live web search with news, papers, and finance verticals
interface.longDescription: All Search adds a live web search surface backed by the AnySearch MCP gateway, which aggregates Exa, Tavily, and Firecrawl behind one connection. Search the web, run several queries in parallel, reach structured verticals such as finance and academic papers, and extract a page into clean Markdown.
